name: Item Pickup / Collect
usage: Played when player receives items or finds clue

name: Menu Window Open
usage: Played when custom HUD or menu opens

name: Invalid Action / Error Buzz
usage: Played when player fails puzzle or has insufficient items

name: Item Recovery / Mate Use
usage: Played when NPC or fountain heals player

name: Switch / Floor Button Chime
usage: Played when puzzle switch is pressed

name: Activated Pillar Sound
usage: Played when ancient monument or terminal activates

name: Mail / Quest Alert Chime
usage: Played when new objective or radio message arrives

name: Quest End Victory Fanfare
usage: Mandatory sound played when quest objective is achieved

name: Quest Accepted Jingle
usage: Played when starting quest at Guild counter
